svg.text: Bore keeps a 2.2 wall to it
1. Stainless steel. 304 is quoted; 316L is the alternative. Alloy not final.
2. Turn the outer profile, neck, shoulder, collar and M18×1 stub. Mill the two collar
3. Bore Ø28 from the nose, then the transition to the Ø12 neck bore. Cut the nose thread
and the face-seal gland from the front.
4. Threads: CAD carries envelopes, not teeth (male M18×1 basic root Ø16.77, female
5. Face-seal gland for a 32 × 1 mm O-ring, 22 % nominal squeeze. No burrs or tool marks
in the gland or on the closure face.
6. Datums: A = Ø12 bore axis. B = rear shoulder face.
7. Polish skin-contact surfaces. Protect threads, gland, closure face and the Ø19.5 bond
8. Free-form surfaces per MetalBody.step. Tolerances to agree with the machinist (ISO
Turned body: M18×1 rear stub, Ø15 neck, Ø28 nose bore, M30×1.5 nose thread
